item_short_desc: Aquaforce Marines Watch Features Quartz Movement, Luminous Hands And Hour Marker, With USMC Eagle, Globe & Anchor Symbol In The Center Of The Face. The Watch Is Also Water Resistant Up To 50m. Officially Licensed by the United States Marine Corps.
